lines.name: Quantum algorithms
lines.about: Designing quantum algorithms and proving how fast they are.

topics.name: Query and time complexity of algorithms
topics.about: Search, quantum walks for search, span programs and transducers, graph and string problems, amplitude amplification, subroutines; upper and lower bounds for specific problems.

topics.name: Hamiltonians, ground states and simulation
topics.about: Ground-state preparation and energy estimation, guided local Hamiltonians, Hamiltonian simulation, quantum PCP and QMA questions about local Hamiltonians.

topics.name: Optimisation and linear algebra
topics.about: Quantum algorithms for SDPs, convex and gradient-based optimisation, eigenvectors, linear systems, matrix problems.

topics.name: Quantum learning theory
topics.about: Learning classical functions with quantum resources: PAC and exact learning, statistical queries, sample complexity, learning and circuit lower bounds.

lines.name: Complexity and mathematics
lines.about: Complexity theory and the mathematics behind quantum information.

topics.name: Complexity theory and lower bounds
topics.about: Quantum and classical complexity classes, the polynomial method, completely bounded forms, communication complexity, fine-grained complexity, classical simulation limits, query lower-bound techniques.

topics.name: Tensors and invariant theory
topics.about: Tensor rank, matrix multiplication, asymptotic spectra, moment polytopes, scaling algorithms, non-commutative optimisation, Shannon capacity and Haemers bounds.

topics.name: Graph theory and quantum walks
topics.about: Spectral and algebraic graph theory, perfect and peak state transfer, continuous- and discrete-time walks as mathematical objects, additive combinatorics.

lines.name: Learning and testing quantum systems
lines.about: Finding out what an unknown quantum state, process or device is, and the symmetry tools for it.

topics.name: Testing and learning quantum states
topics.about: Property testing (stabilizer, product, Gaussian states), tomography, shadow tomography, learning Hamiltonians and channels, sample complexity.

topics.name: Symmetry and representation theory
topics.about: Schur-Weyl duality, port-based teleportation, cloning, purification, unitary designs, random unitaries, quantum Fourier transforms over groups.

topics.name: Benchmarking quantum hardware
topics.about: Randomized benchmarking, characterising gates and noise, benchmark suites for devices.

lines.name: Quantum information theory
lines.about: What quantum information is and what it can do, quantitatively.

topics.name: Entanglement and resource theories
topics.about: Entanglement distillation and cost, relative entropies, resource theories, catalysis, continuity of entropies, asymptotic rates.

topics.name: Channels and communication
topics.about: Channel capacities, communication with quantum resources, teleportation and networks as information-theoretic questions, non-locality and Bell inequalities.

topics.name: Many-body physics, holography and gravity
topics.about: Entanglement in many-body systems, tensor networks, renormalisation, holography, quantum gravity, scars, field theory.

topics.name: Foundations and thermodynamics
topics.about: Quantum foundations, measurement theory, quasiprobabilities, general probabilistic theories, tests of quantum gravity, quantum thermodynamics and batteries.

lines.name: Quantum cryptography and security
lines.about: Security with and against quantum computers.

topics.name: Position verification and non-local computation
topics.about: Quantum position verification, attacks on it, non-local quantum computation, related non-local games.

topics.name: Quantum cryptographic protocols
topics.about: QKD and device independence, oblivious transfer, multi-party computation, delegated and verifiable computation, uncloneable cryptography, quantum money and signatures of quantum states.

topics.name: Post-quantum and quantum-secure cryptography
topics.about: Security of classical cryptography against quantum attackers: QROM, Fiat-Shamir, hash functions and sponges, encryption notions, lattices, isogenies (CSIDH), attacks on schemes.

lines.name: Error correction and quantum software
lines.about: Making quantum computers reliable and programmable.

topics.name: Error correction and fault tolerance
topics.about: Codes, decoding, fault-tolerant state preparation, logical operations, thresholds.

topics.name: Circuits, compilation and ZX-calculus
topics.about: Circuit synthesis and optimisation, rewrite rules, ZX-calculus, routing, catalytic and space-efficient circuits, classical simulation of circuits, programming languages and tools.

lines.name: Quantum simulation and applications
lines.about: Using quantum computers for chemistry, physics and other applications.

topics.name: Chemistry and materials
topics.about: Electronic structure on quantum computers, quantum chemistry methods, catalysis, multiscale modelling, materials.

topics.name: Near-term and variational algorithms
topics.about: Variational algorithms, QAOA, NISQ applications and resource estimates, quantum machine learning on near-term devices, industrial use cases.

lines.name: Experimental quantum physics
lines.about: Building and controlling quantum systems in the lab.

topics.name: Trapped ions and ion-atom systems
topics.about: Trapped-ion gates and simulation, optical tweezers for ions, ion-atom collisions and molecules.

topics.name: Cold atoms and laser cooling
topics.about: Strontium and other cold atoms, laser cooling, Bose-Einstein condensates, atomic clocks, optical tweezers for atoms, Rydberg atoms, polar molecules.

topics.name: Sensing and atom interferometry
topics.about: Atom interferometers, inertial sensors, metrology, displacement sensing.

topics.name: Condensed matter experiments
topics.about: Spectroscopy and transport in materials: superconductors, charge density waves, strange metals.

lines.name: Quantum and society
lines.about: Philosophy, ethics, law and policy of quantum science and technology.

topics.name: Philosophy of physics and technology
topics.about: Interpretation, black holes and information, technological understanding, explanation.

topics.name: Ethics, law and policy
topics.about: Responsible quantum technology, governance, regulation, security policy, societal impact.

lines.name: Other
lines.about: Not research on quantum science, or purely classical work outside the lines above.
